description: Schema version for IB3W weather context rows.
Timestamp when the context file is generated.
Weather SQLite database path or source identifier.
Optional DB hash/version/snapshot id if available.
Route folder or route family id.
Route/case id aligned with upstream pipeline.
Activity id when context is activity-specific.
Window id when context is window-level.
Segment id when context is segment-level.
One of activity, route, window, segment.
Activity/window start time used for alignment.
Activity/window end time used for alignment.
Observation interval start time if applicable.
Observation interval end time if applicable.
Minimum absolute gap in minutes between activity/window and observation.
Share of activity/window covered by acceptable observations.
Lookback window for antecedent rain/weather features.
Source category such as weather_station, rainfall_station, hydro_station, forecast, static_terrain.
Provider name if known.
Station/source id if applicable.
Station/source name if applicable.
Raw source DB table.
Raw source DB column.
Canonical variable such as rainfall, temperature, humidity, wind_speed, wind_direction, water_level.
Observed or imputed numeric value. Null when missing.
Text value for categorical/unknown states.
Unit for numeric value.
Aggregation method such as sum, mean, max, latest, nearest, carry_forward, interpolation.
One of OBSERVED, IMPUTED, MISSING, INFERRED_FROM_BEHAVIOR. v1 excludes INFERRED_FROM_BEHAVIOR from observed/imputed context.
Reason for MISSING, e.g. NO_SOURCE, NO_OBSERVATION_IN_WINDOW, FAILED_QUALITY_GATE, UNSUPPORTED_VARIABLE.
Required when context_type=IMPUTED.
0-1 confidence score from source quality and alignment gates.
Pipe-separated quality flags.
Distance from station/source to nearest route or representative point.
Share of route/window adequately represented by selected source(s).
Elevation difference between route/window and source station.
Rank among candidate sources after quality gating.
Number of sources contributing to aggregation or imputation.
Whether candidate sources materially disagree.
True if row exists to mark a deprecated fallback or blocked migration behavior.
Free-text notes for audit/debug only.
